newsitem.title: UK: Greece to launch 1.0 bln mark 10-yr bond Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Greece to launch 1.0 bln mark 10-yr bond Thursday.

text.p: Greece will launch a 1.0 billion mark 10-year Eurobond tomorrow, joint lead manager DG Bank said on Wednesday.
The launch spread will be in the low 80s basis points over Bunds. Merrill Lynch will be the other joint lead manager.
Greece last tapped the international bond market in March with a $500 million callable seven-year FRN.
It launched a 1.0 billion mark seven-year bond in January at a 100 b.p. spread.
Greece raised 130 billion yen via a Samurai bond in July.
